svg.aria-label: How PostStream runs two ways. The same React app talks to /post and /auth either way. The full app sends those requests to a Node and Express server that keeps posts, replies and follows in PostgreSQL. The archived demo at poststream.joekarlsson.com is built with npm run build:demo and has no server: a stand-in inside the browser answers the same requests from localStorage, signs you in as a sample visitor, and a sample cast posts or replies every 12 to 25 seconds and answers your own posts within 6 to 14 seconds.
